title: Geospatial Vector Geometry as a Native Spatial Modality for Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.16769v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Geospatial reasoning links VLMs to real-world action and decision making. Reliable reasoning requires accurate spatial information and effective spatial representations. However, current VLMs obtain this information mainly from language and vision. At larger geographic scales, limited visual observations make it difficult to establish accurate spatial references and recover precise spatial relations. This leads to a bottleneck for VLM spatial perception and reasoning. This paper proposes that geospatial vector geometry can become a native spatial modality within a VLM and introduces GeoVec-VLM. First, we develop a structured geometry representation that preserves the spatial structure and arrangement of vector objects, building an explicit spatial basis. translated_title: 地理空间矢量几何作为视觉-语言模型的原生空间模态
translated_abstract: 地理空间推理将视觉-语言模型（VLM）与现实世界的行动和决策联系起来。可靠的推理需要准确的空间信息和有效的空间表示。然而，当前的VLM主要从语言和视觉中获取这些信息。在较大的地理尺度上，有限的视觉观测使得难以建立准确的空间参照并恢复精确的空间关系，这导致了VLM空间感知与推理的瓶颈。本文提出地理空间矢量几何可以成为VLM内部的原生空间模态，并引入了GeoVec-VLM。首先，我们开发了一种结构化几何表示，能够保留矢量对象的空间结构与排布，从而构建显式的空间基础。其次，我们引入一种几何交互策略，将这一空间基础融入多模态计算中，使其能够依据问题与视觉内容和语言指称进行交互。
tldr: 该论文提出将地理空间矢量几何作为视觉-语言模型的原生空间模态，通过结构化几何表示与几何交互策略构建GeoVec-VLM，以突破大地理尺度下VLM空间感知与推理的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes treating geospatial vector geometry as a native spatial modality for vision-language models, introducing GeoVec-VLM with a structured geometry representation and a geometry interaction strategy to overcome bottlenecks in spatial perception and reasoning at large geographic scales.
